craft_notes: Sthāyin: rest after weighing. Device: end-dash→comma (weighing softens onto pausing). Rejected: 'rest' for 'pause' — killed: viśrāmyan pauses mid-flicker, rest would end the motion early. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Counted crores of charges, through fancy's flicker,
I pause, Bhava, and banquet deep in mind-joy of thee.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam

reads_against.argmap: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness.; Resting, O Bhava, in your mind-bliss I delight greatly. → Resting from countless duties in your mind-bliss, I delight.
c1_essence: Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.
reads_against.l2: Pondered though crores of duties be, through mind's restlessness — I rest, O Bhava, and revel deeply in the bliss of mind in you.
